// Production Azure AKS Cluster with Private Endpoints & Managed Identity
resource aksCluster 'Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters@2024-02-01' = {
  name: 'cg-prod-aks-cluster'
  location: resourceGroup().location
  identity: { type: 'SystemAssigned' }
  properties: {
    dnsPrefix: 'cg-aks-prod'
    enableRBAC: true
    networkProfile: {
      networkPlugin: 'azure'
      networkPolicy: 'calico'
      loadBalancerSku: 'standard'
    }
    agentPoolProfiles: [{
      name: 'systempool'
      count: 3
      vmSize: 'Standard_D4s_v5'
      osType: 'Linux'
      enableAutoScaling: true
      minCount: 3
      maxCount: 64
    }]
  }
}
